concerns.rationale: A simulation job and its evidence are discrete records; measured and predicted values must remain distinguishable.
Modelica solves equation systems; FMI/SSP carry executable model interfaces and composition, not ordinary durable-state transitions.
Reproducing a result needs numerical and environment assumptions beyond content identity.

concerns.description: Step selection, rollback and event synchronization
concerns.rationale: FMI master algorithm and capabilities stay in specialized realization; changing step can affect approximation quality.
CPU placement/caching is replaceable within declared numerical compatibility limits.

facets.meaning: A rerun must disclose solver/step/tolerance assumptions; byte identity alone does not promise identical floating-point output.
obligations: Define observable tolerance and event alignment before comparing runs.
Capture FMU dependencies and tool/platform versions.
No runtime enforcement or numerical equivalence checker is implemented.

realization.strategy: Digest-bound request to external simulation master; admit correlated result and immutable trajectory identity.
